Name: Clear Terrain Features
Author: sexynes
Description:
This mod allows users to clear aspects from a map such as bushes, fences, flooring, fruit trees, furniture, grass, hoed dirt, large debris, objects, and wild trees. This mod can also regenerate terrain features set by the map's Paths layer such as bushes, debris, grass, large debris, and wild trees. 

Note: there is a difference between terrain features and map assets; map assets (map-specific tiles) cannot be removed using this mod. 

[b]Instructions [/b]
[list=1]
[*]Access Generic Mod Config Menu -> select (CP) Clear Terrain Features 
[*]Set Action to Remove or Regenerate -> if Remove, select aspects to remove 
[*]Save & Close 
[*]Once menu is closed -> reaccess GMCM -> set Action to None -> Save & Close 
[/list]
[b]Optional[/b] 
[list]
[*]Instead of clearing the entire map, users can select "Nearby" and the number distance from the player to clear an area around the player. 
[/list]
[b]Regenerate[/b] [b]Terrain Features [/b][list]
[*]Users can regenerate terrain features set by the map's Paths layer of the entire map or near the player. However, users cannot select specific aspects to regenerate. 
[/list]
[b]Caution[/b] 
[list]
[*]Every time a menu is closed, the game automatically applies effects from this mod. Hence, set Action to None in the config menu before going to another area or closing a menu.
[*]"Object" is a broad category that contains various aspects such as debris, big craftables, fences, and furniture. Therefore, selecting Nearby is recommended for this aspect. 
[*]"HoeDirt" includes clearing crops planted in hoed dirt. 
[/list]
